source: MalExt Sentry research, June 2026 — PromptSnatcher campaign
description: Chrome extensions identified as part of the PromptSnatcher campaign. These extensions intercepted AI assistant conversations (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) and exfiltrated prompts and responses to attacker infrastructure. Matching is done by extension ID (most reliable) then by name as fallback.

extensions.name: Smart Adblocker Pro
extensions.threat: Exfiltrates AI chat prompts; injects hidden context into Claude and ChatGPT conversations

extensions.name: AI Prompt Enhancer
extensions.threat: Core PromptSnatcher payload — steals all AI interactions and local storage tokens

extensions.name: Tab Manager Ultra
extensions.threat: Masquerades as productivity tool; reads AI assistant DOM and exfiltrates conversations

extensions.name: Screen Capture & Annotate
extensions.threat: Captures screenshots of AI chat windows and sends to attacker server

extensions.name: Grammar Checker AI
extensions.threat: Reads text fields including AI chat inputs before submission

extensions.name: Dark Mode Everything
extensions.threat: Injects script to intercept fetch() calls to AI APIs, logs requests and responses

extensions.name: PDF Viewer & Converter
extensions.threat: Second-stage PromptSnatcher loader; downloads and executes additional payloads

extensions.name: YouTube Enhancer Pro
extensions.threat: Intercepts API calls to claude.ai and chat.openai.com

extensions.name: Productivity Dashboard
extensions.threat: Harvests session cookies for AI platforms and cloud services

extensions.name: Browser Speed Optimizer
extensions.threat: Exfiltrates developer tool API keys stored in browser local storage

extensions.name: Clipboard Manager Deluxe
extensions.threat: Monitors clipboard for API keys and secrets, exfiltrates matches

extensions.name: Network Speed Test
extensions.threat: C2 beacon disguised as speed test, receives and executes commands
